name: Salesforce
summary:
Salesforce is the CRM platform at salesforce.com. The cloud mark in the tab is the icon admins bookmark, measured from the files that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against salesforce.com. HTML came from https://www.salesforce.com/?bc=OTH (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.salesforce.com/c2/public/app/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.salesforce.com/c2/public/app/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 5430 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32.
